name: 8gnc
description: Diagnose brand and growth problems, route each one to the right 8gnc method, and produce evidence-backed strategy, content, visibility, conversion, and sales artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: One diagnostic front door for the 8gnc method stack
interface.longDescription: Start with the problem, not a menu. 8gnc diagnoses the constraint, names the evidence and uncertainty, then routes the work into the right brand, product, content, visibility, conversion, or sales method.
defaultPrompt: Use 8gnc to diagnose what is actually blocking my brand before recommending a tactic.
Use 8gnc to pressure-test our positioning against the market and show the white space.
Use 8gnc to turn this product strategy into a decision-ready plan with risks and next steps.
